args: When a PR edits a shared test helper or nested module such as `tests/support/mod.rs` or `tests/phase35_docs_doc_cli/missing_errors.rs`, this filter accepts it because the adapter glob includes `tests/**/*.rs`, then `_target_name` turns it into `mod`/`missing_errors` and the runner executes `cargo test --test <name>`.
